decisions.decision: Use Grafana's per-dashboard public-dashboard feature, not a shared viewer credential, for the portfolio-facing links
decisions.rationale: A shared Viewer login is org-wide (Explore access, any future dashboard, not scoped to the 3 intended ones) and not individually revocable; a public-dashboard link is hard-scoped by Grafana to that one dashboard's stored queries and can be disabled independently

decisions.decision: Pin cAdvisor's $container to 'app' rather than leaving at 'All' or pinning some other container
decisions.rationale: Leaving at 'All' reveals the full production container topology (every service name) in the public legends; 'app' is the one genuinely interesting to a portfolio viewer. Accepted brittleness: the exact container name has a Compose-generated suffix that could shift on redeploy, but the failure mode is a blank panel, not a worse disclosure.

decisions.decision: Node Exporter Full and Postgres Internals confirmed safe to publish without further panel-level changes
decisions.rationale: Node Exporter Full's nodename resolves to the node-exporter container's own hostname, not the real VM hostname (docker-compose.prod.yml sets hostname: node-exporter). Postgres Internals' worst-case disclosure via Database=All is just the two db names (kanban_prod/kanban_nonprod), no credentials or hostnames.

decisions.decision: deploy.yml fix: explicitly enumerate the 4 missing paths in source:, add a CI gate, rather than wildcarding docker/** or leaving it unguarded
decisions.rationale: A docker/ wildcard would ship docker/caddy/Dockerfile (a build-only artifact) to the VM and, combined with rm:, risks deleting .env.prod; an unguarded fix leaves the exact same drift class open for the next added mount. The gate (scripts/verify-deploy-scp-coverage.py) is proven to fail against the pre-fix state and pass against the fix.
